hero.subtitulo: Building a better future through innovation, solidarity, and social commitment

mision.texto: To contribute to the integral development of communities surrounding the Pico de Orizaba National Park by strengthening their social, economic, and environmental resilience.

vision.descripcion: We aspire to be a benchmark of inclusive and sustainable community transformation.
vision.punto1: Conserve and restore the environment of the Pico de Orizaba National Park.
vision.punto2: Guarantee basic services and reduce marginalization and social lag.
vision.punto3: Improve the quality of education and healthcare.
vision.punto4: Promote local and solidarity-based economic development that creates decent jobs.
vision.punto5: Channel the strength and leadership of youth as a driving force for transformation.
vision.punto6: Exercise good governance and financial transparency, inspiring trust among donors and partners.

ods.descripcion1: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
ods.descripcion2: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
ods.punto3: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
ods.descripcion3: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
ods.descripcion4: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
ods.descripcion5: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
ods.descripcion6: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
ods.descripcion7: Sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss.
ods.punto8: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
ods.descripcion8: Promote just, peaceful and inclusive societies.
ods.descripcion9: Revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development and strengthen the means of implementation.

faqsLeft.pregunta: What type of projects does CIMA A.C. develop?
faqsLeft.respuesta: We develop projects focused on environmental conservation, education, health, local economic development and community strengthening.

faqsLeft.respuesta: Our team is composed of multidisciplinary professionals committed to social development.

faqsRight.pregunta: How can I participate as a volunteer?
faqsRight.respuesta: You can contact us through our volunteer form or attend our recruitment sessions.
Yes, we accept both in-kind and monetary donations to support our projects.

iniciativas.subtitulo: Projects that transform communities and protect our natural environment

items.descripcionLarga: Comprehensive reforestation program in Pico de Orizaba National Park, focused on native species and restoration of degraded ecosystems to combat climate change.
Vocational guidance program aimed at young people from rural communities, providing tools for academic and professional decision-making aligned with their interests and local development.
Community health campaigns that include medical consultations, vaccination campaigns, preventive health education and nutrition programs to improve families' quality of life.
Implementation of digital literacy programs and access to educational technologies to reduce the digital divide in rural communities and improve educational opportunities.
Entrepreneurship training programs, microcredits and development of local productive chains to generate decent jobs and strengthen the community economy.
Local flora and fauna conservation initiatives, environmental education and promotion of sustainable practices for the protection of Pico de Orizaba National Park.

faq.subtitulo: We resolve the most common questions about the donation process

uso.respuesta: Your donation goes directly to our community development, education, health and environmental sustainability programs. We maintain complete transparency in the use of funds.

proyectos.pregunta: What projects does my donation impact?
proyectos.respuesta: Your contribution supports educational programs, community health campaigns, environmental sustainability projects and youth empowerment in vulnerable communities.

seguridad.pregunta: Is it safe to donate online?
seguridad.respuesta: Yes, we use Stripe, a secure payment platform with bank-level encryption. Your data is completely protected.

datos.respuesta: Absolutely. We comply with all data protection regulations and never share your personal information with third parties.

fiscal.pregunta: Can I get a tax deduction?
fiscal.respuesta: Yes, as a registered organization, you can deduct your donation from taxes. We will send you the corresponding tax receipt.

recibo.pregunta: How long does it take to receive my receipt?
recibo.respuesta: You will receive your tax receipt by email within 24-48 hours after your donation.

beneficios.pregunta: What benefits do I get as a donor?
beneficios.respuesta: You will receive regular updates on the impact of your donation, invitations to special events and recognition in our annual reports.

contacto.pregunta: Can I contact someone if I have questions?
contacto.respuesta: Of course. You can contact us by email, phone or social media. Our team will be happy to resolve all your questions.

recursos.descripcion: Stay informed about our latest activities, events and achievements in community development

campana_dental.descripcion_corta: We launch our new campaign to improve oral health in rural communities with free care and preventive education.
campana_dental.descripcion_larga: The campaign will last 3 months and visit 15 communities in hard-to-reach areas. We will have a team of 10 volunteer dentists and distribute more than 5,000 oral hygiene kits. This project is possible thanks to the support of our strategic partners and donors committed to community health.

taller_voluntarios.descripcion_corta: Intensive training for new volunteers who will join our social programs this quarter.
taller_voluntarios.descripcion_larga: The workshop will be held over two consecutive weekends and will include modules on: basic first aid, effective communication with vulnerable communities, safety protocols and ethics in social work. Participants will receive certification endorsed by the Ministry of Health and the National University. Limited spaces, prior registration required.

logros.certificacion: Certification endorsed by the Ministry of Health

programa_alimentacion.descripcion_corta: We present the impressive results of our school feeding program in rural areas.
programa_alimentacion.descripcion_larga: During the last semester, our program has benefited more than 1,200 children in 8 rural schools, providing nutritious breakfasts 5 days a week. The results show a 30% improvement in school performance and a 45% reduction in anemia cases among participants.

jornada_medica.descripcion_corta: Free medical care day for the community with specialties in pediatrics, gynecology and general medicine.
jornada_medica.descripcion_larga: We will offer completely free general medical, dental and ophthalmological consultations. In addition, we will perform basic laboratory tests (glucose, hemoglobin, blood pressure) and vaccination according to the national schedule. The day will have 25 health professionals and is expected to serve more than 500 people. No prior appointment required, care on a first-come, first-served basis.

conferencia_salud.descripcion_corta: Master conference with international experts in public health and health policies.
conferencia_salud.descripcion_larga: We will have the participation of 5 international experts who will discuss current challenges in global public health, strategies to improve health systems in developing countries and the role of community organizations. The event will include discussion panels, Q&A sessions, and networking with speakers. Participation certificates will be awarded.

feria_emprendimiento.descripcion_corta: Annual event that brings together social entrepreneurs with investors and mentors.
feria_emprendimiento.descripcion_larga: The fair is the most important meeting point for social entrepreneurship in the region. This year we will have 50 entrepreneur stands, 10 keynote speeches and investment rounds. Participants will be able to present their projects to potential investors and receive specialized mentoring.

campana_vacunacion.descripcion_corta: Massive vaccination campaign for children under 5 years old.
campana_vacunacion.descripcion_larga: In collaboration with the Ministry of Health, we carried out a vaccination day that covered all vaccines in the national schedule for preschool children. The campaign reached more than 800 children in 3 days and had the support of 15 volunteer health professionals.
